_what: How a file a buyer receives from a paid Marketplace tool run is made traceable to that sale (src/sold-copies.mjs). Every such file is recorded by its content identity with its sale and an opaque buyer tag in the shared pool; where the file's type has a carrier here, an overt note naming the sale is added first, so each buyer's copy has its own identity. A carrier is the bytes added at the end of the file, written as parts: {"text"} literal text, {"note": true} the note, {"length": "u32be"} the whole addition's length as four big-endian bytes. Each carrier lists the media types whose readers ignore those bytes. A type with no carrier is still traced by its identity. Adding a format is one row here. Decision source:security-hardening-buyer-attribution-2026-10-05.

words.not_yours: That file or sale is not one of your tools' sales.
words.unknown: No sale of your tools delivered that file.
